Sign in to your Claude plan
  KeepState starts a private machine
  that runs Claude Code's own sign-in
  for you. You open a link, sign in to
  Claude, and paste the code it shows.
  The machine is destroyed afterwards,
  and the token is never shown to you or
  kept here.

  Starting a private sign-in machine and
  asking Claude for a sign-in link. This
  takes about a minute.

  is still working, and Ctrl-C cancels
  it and cleans up.
